profileEvidence.summary: Friendly confidence and close companionship are central breeding aims for Petite Goldendoodles. These small Golden Retriever–Poodle crosses can enjoy lively games and settling beside their people. Their maintained size class is below 14 inches at the shoulder. It includes first crosses and later generations, with soft coats ranging from straight to wavy or curly.
profileEvidence.shortDescription: A small companion cross bred for friendly confidence, Petite Goldendoodles often enjoy play and staying close to people.
